## What changes? / 改了什么？

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.
说明问题及改动后的行为，有关联 issue 时请附链接。

## Validation / 验证

List relevant checks and their outcomes. For live window or Space changes, include macOS version/build, display setup, and SIP state. Distinguish automated tests from manual verification; mark anything not tested.
列出实际执行的检查与结果，真实窗口行为请注明系统、屏幕和 SIP 状态。未验证项请明确说明。
